Nora (marketing): Hey team — for the webinar demo we want a reproducible artifact set showing coldstart vs steady-state and streaming token latency. Need a short blurb for the slide that says how we measured streaming p50/p95 and a minimal artifact bundle people can re-run.

Sam (eng-runtime): Got it. A couple clarifying q's: 1) demo will show a live two-stream interactive session with streaming tokens, 2) do you want coldstart defined as a fresh container start or a cold connection to an already-warmed pod?

Nora (marketing): Fresh container start please — we want to show the worst-case first-response for live demos. Also include steady-state at concurrency=2 and a tiny burst profile (10 quick sessions) so we can show graceful degradation.

Liam (measurements): We'll need the exact payloads for streaming tests because tokenization affects first-token timing. Nora — can you confirm whether demo prompts are primarily short chat turns (~15-30 tokens) or longer instructions?

Nora (marketing): Short chat turns. I'll upload a demo slice of 120 prompts, focused on 1-turn Q&A and 10% multi-turn followups. Put it in s3://marketing-artifacts/bench/4341006789/demo_slice.csv.

Sam (eng-runtime): Nice. Proposed artifact list to publish: run-config.txt (model tag, docker image, bench harness commit), run-script one-liner, raw streaming traces with first-token timestamps, aggregated streaming percentiles (first-token p50/p95), coldstart first-byte times, steady-state p50/p95, per-request cost, and a README explaining KV-cache/connection reuse settings. We'll also include the docker tag so external folks can reproduce.

Liam (measurements): For CI we recommend 4 repeated coldstart runs (fresh container each time) and 6 steady-state runs with a 30s warmup between trials. For streaming, log both time-to-first-byte and time-between-subsequent-chunks. We'll compute percentile bands across trials.

Sam (eng-runtime): Quick note: streaming numbers vary a bit with chunk-size config. We'll lock chunk_size=32 tokens for the published runs and note the tradeoff. Also we need to decide on fallback routing: should we run with the live routing policy (multi-model fallback enabled) or pin to a single model?

Nora (marketing): Pin to single model for the headline. Add a brief FAQ entry showing the routing fallback effect with a single extra trial that toggles fallback on.

Liam (measurements): I can prepare a small notebook that plots first-token CDFs for coldstart vs steady-state and overlays burst failure rate. Will upload PNGs.

ci-bot: scheduled bench job 4341006789 -> https://ci.internal/bench/4341006789 (running)

Sam (eng-runtime): Example one-liner for the repo for a single steady-state run (requires bench creds):

REDWOOD_API_KEY=redacted ./bench/run_streaming.sh --model redwood-demo-1.2 --slice s3://marketing-artifacts/bench/4341006789/demo_slice.csv --mode steady --concurrency 2 --chunk_size 32 --output s3://marketing-artifacts/bench/4341006789/run-1/

Sam (eng-runtime): For coldstart we run a restart helper that tears down the container between requests. We'll include the helper in the repo and the exact docker tag: redwood/bench-harness:2026-03-21-rc4.

Liam (measurements): Uploaded demo slice and manifest to s3://marketing-artifacts/bench/4341006789/demo_slice.csv. Manifest lists tokenizer version and sample buckets.

ci-bot: bench job 4341006789 completed: artifacts at s3://marketing-artifacts/bench/4341006789/summary.json

Sam (eng-runtime): Artifacts uploaded. Summary highlights: streaming first-token isolated coldstart p50=210ms p95=430ms; steady-state first-token p50=34ms p95=120ms; inter-chunk median=8ms. Burst (10 quick sessions) saw 5% requests degrade >2x on p95 due to queueing at concurrency limit. Per-request token cost delta in steady-state vs coldstart presented. Full run-config and runtime.log present in bucket.

Nora (marketing): These numbers look good for the slides. Can you add a one-sentence methodology blurb for the webinar notes and a 2-line caveat about variability for streaming?

Sam (eng-runtime): Suggested blurb: "Streaming latencies measured as time-to-first-token and inter-chunk intervals on a curated demo slice; coldstart measured with fresh container restarts and steady-state averaged over multiple warm runs. Repro artifacts and run scripts available at s3://marketing-artifacts/bench/4341006789/." Caveat: streaming latency depends on chunk_size and network jitter; expect variance in live demos.

Liam (measurements): PNGs for CDFs and burst heatmap uploaded: s3://marketing-artifacts/bench/4341006789/plots/first_token_cdf.png, burst_heatmap.png

Nora (marketing): Perfect — thanks all. We'll reference the artifact bundle in the slide notes and include the FAQ item for routing fallback. Ping when you want us to review wording.

Sam (eng-runtime): Will do a final pass on the README and ping here when the public README link is live.

Nora (marketing): Closing loop — appreciate it! :rocket:
